GTMP.description: Temperature Gradient Loads (GTMP). Each entry is keyed by an element key and carries an ITEMS array; each item's TYPE (1: Beam / 2: Plate) selects which fields apply, with TY/USE_HY/HY used only when TYPE=1.

ITEMS.description: List of temperature gradient load items assigned to the element key.

ID.description: Serial number of this item within the element key.

LCNAME.description: Static load case name; must reference an existing load case.

GROUP_NAME.description: Load group name; if non-empty must reference an existing load group. Empty string means no group.

TYPE.description: Temperature gradient type: 1 = Beam, 2 = Plate. Selects which fields apply (TY/USE_HY/HY apply only when TYPE=1).

TZ.description: Temperature gradient in the local z-direction (T2z - T1z).

USE_HZ.description: When true, use the section property height Hz instead of the supplied HZ value.

HZ.description: Height Hz in the local z-direction (used when USE_HZ is false).

TY.description: [TYPE=1] Temperature gradient in the local y-direction (T2y - T1y). Beam type only.

USE_HY.description: [TYPE=1] When true, use the section property height Hy instead of the supplied HY value. Beam type only.

HY.description: [TYPE=1] Height Hy in the local y-direction (used when USE_HY is false). Beam type only.
